name: PERSON_SELF
authority_effect: Identifies self-capacity only; final permission still evaluated
restriction_notes: Cannot confer organization or provider authority

name: GUARDIAN_PROTECTED_PARTICIPANT
canonical_source: Item 03 with Agreement and Safeguarding sources
required_evidence: Current legal/approved basis; agreement; safeguarding restrictions
restriction_notes: Shared address or payment is insufficient

name: OWNER_HORSE
required_evidence: Current horse record; source authority; dispute state
restriction_notes: Possession or payment alone is insufficient

name: LESSEE_HORSE
required_evidence: Current agreement; horse; parties; scope; dates; restrictions
restriction_notes: Never implies ownership or unrestricted transfer

name: FACILITY_MEMBER
authority_effect: Supplies context and candidate capacity only
required_evidence: Current identity; facility/tenant context; accepted relationship
restriction_notes: Facility association and role do not grant permission

name: ORGANIZATION_REPRESENTATIVE
required_evidence: Organization source authority; acceptance; scope; accountable actor
restriction_notes: Organization association or email domain is insufficient

name: STAFF_ENGAGEMENT
authority_effect: Supplies descriptive relationship and possible authority input
restriction_notes: Job title or schedule assignment is insufficient

name: PROVIDER_CLIENT
authority_effect: Supplies provider relationship input under GFD-003
required_evidence: Canonical parties; accountable humans; source basis; purpose; scope; dates
restriction_notes: Profile API appointment payment and portal status are insufficient

name: PROVIDER_ORGANIZATION_ACTOR
authority_effect: Supplies representation candidate for provider action
required_evidence: Canonical organization; actor; representation source; acceptance; scope
restriction_notes: Provider credential or organization login is insufficient

name: DELEGATOR_DELEGATE
authority_effect: Carries only an accepted bounded delegation
required_evidence: Current source authority; grant; acceptance; scope; expiry; restrictions
restriction_notes: Cannot exceed or survive source authority

name: SUPPORT_CASE_ACCESS
authority_effect: Supplies a ticketed time-bound support basis
required_evidence: Approved ticket; purpose; scope; approver; start/expiry; notice rule
restriction_notes: No invisible impersonation or global support authority

name: SYSTEM_ACTOR_DELEGATION
authority_effect: Supplies only an explicitly governed automated action basis
required_evidence: Named actor; owner; policy; action; purpose; tenant; expiry; watermark
